<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that, in the forward direction, form an ether oxygen and create C‑C and C‑O bonds (atom types 6‑6 and 6‑8) while breaking a C‑O bond (6‑8). This should retrieve the template for the intramolecular Michael cyclization of chalcones to flavanones.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1CC(O)C2=CC=CC=C2O1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
